_meta.openai/annotationJustification: Creates or replaces a route row pointing at a content key.

description: Create/replace route; contentKey derived from path if omitted. On a field that accepts null (contentKey, redirectTo, redirectStatus, preserveQuery), sending null clears it back to its default.

contentKey.description: Explicit content key (defaults to a path-derived key when omitted). null clears an explicit key back to that path default — same as omitting it, but usable on a PATCH to undo a prior set.

context.description: One sentence: why you are calling this tool and what you are trying to accomplish. Stored on the site's activity log and visible to everyone on the site — never put secrets or personal data here.

changeNote.description: One line on what the variant changes (0.56e M2). Kept here so route PATCH round-trips (weights/settings updates) don't strip it.

goalId.description: Optional Dotsy conversion goal; omit when tracking in external analytics.

handsOff.description: Hands-off mode (0.56e M4): the daily sweep may auto-promote a ≥95% winner or auto-end keep-A after 30 days. Prefer setting this via start_test; kept here so route PATCH round-trips (weights/settings updates) don't strip the flag.

id.description: Stable experiment slug — cookie namespace; unique per site forever.
Variant arm id — default "a" / "b" on create.

guestToken.description: Guest token from start_site. Send it on every call until claim_site. Omit when this chat is already signed in to Dotsy.

layout.description: Layout NAME, bare: "default" for layouts/default.html — not the file key. It must already exist as layouts/<name>.html (400 layout_not_found otherwise). null removes the layout.

menu.description: Menu this page joins — matches a <dotsy-nav menu="…"> in the layout/fragment (e.g. "primary", "footer").

order.description: Sort position among siblings in this menu, ascending. Use gaps (10, 20, 30) to leave room for inserts.

parent.description: Parent route path within this menu for a nested/dropdown item (e.g. "/services"). Omit for top level.

nav.description: DEPRECATED — use put_menu_item / menu API. Menu memberships on the route row. Still accepted during transition and synced to menu items. See get_skill('nav').

navLabel.description: DEPRECATED — use put_menu_item / menu API. Menu link text for <dotsy-nav> (separate from title). Still accepted during transition and synced to menu items.

noindex.description: Exclude from sitemap/RSS; inject noindex meta (0.69).

preserveQuery.description: Append the visitor's original query string to the redirect target (default true on a redirect). null clears an explicit override.

redirectStatus.description: 301 permanent / 302 or 308 temporary (default 301 on a redirect). null clears an explicit override.

redirectTo.description: Redirect target, a root-relative path (/…). Required when purpose is "redirect". null clears it — only valid once purpose stops being "redirect" (a redirect route always needs a target).

name: put_route
